before.requirement: Exercise dumping of a supported constructed value deep enough to reach depth JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH. Before g0005, do_dump recursively handled that depth without the new rejection.
before.reason: The old harness obtains dump values only from json_loadb. The unchanged parser rejects values deeper than its limit, while dumping starts the root at depth zero; the harness constructs no deeper value.

after.requirement: Exercise the g0005 rejection when dumping a supported constructed value reaches depth JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
after.reason: The new guard is present, but the same unchanged parser limit prevents a successfully loaded value from reaching it. The harness still has no value-construction step.

claims.reason: The parser depth check and the harness's parse-then-dump-only setup are identical on both sides. g0005 adds a rejection behind that existing constraint.
